nodes.description: Owner address state variable declared in Ownable; assigned from msg.sender in constructors and mutated by renounceOwnership/transferOwnership.
Total fragment supply, initialized to INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY in the EthereumHyper constructor.
Conversion rate between fragments and gons; computed once in the constructor as TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply).
Mapping address => gon balance; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; written by approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and transferFrom.
Ownable constructor: assigns _owner = msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
View function returning the current _owner address.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to address(0).
onlyOwner function that replaces _owner with newOwner after a zero-address check.
Modifier that requires _owner == msg.sender before executing the modified function body.
Token constructor: sets _owner = msg.sender, initializes _totalSupply, mints TOTAL_GONS to the owner and derives _gonsPerFragment.
View function returning the cached _totalSupply value.
View function returning _gonBalances[who].div(_gonsPerFragment).
Public transfer guarded by validRecipient; converts fragments to gons and updates both balances.
View function returning _allowedFragments[owner_][spender].
Public transferFrom guarded by validRecipient; deducts allowance and moves gon balances.
Sets _allowedFragments[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval.
Atomically adds addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender.
Atomically subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for spender, clamping at zero.
Modifier that reverts when the recipient equals address(this).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, owner checks, allowance keys and balance debits.
SafeMath.sub used to deduct gonValue from the sender's gon balance in transfer.
SafeMath.add used to credit gonValue to the recipient's gon balance in transfer.
SafeMath.mul converting fragment value into gon units using _gonsPerFragment in transfer.
SafeMath.sub reducing the caller's allowance by value in transferFrom.
SafeMath.mul converting fragment value into gon units inside transferFrom.
SafeMath.add raising the caller's allowance in increaseAllowance.
SafeMath.sub lowering the caller's allowance in decreaseAllowance.
Access-control comparison _owner == msg.sender performed by the onlyOwner modifier.
Parameter 'to' (recipient) of transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter 'value' (fragment amount) of transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter 'from' (debited account) of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
Parameter 'to' (credited account) of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
Parameter 'value' (fragment amount) of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address,uint256).
Parameter 'spender' of increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
Parameter 'addedValue' of increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
Parameter 'spender' of decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).
Parameter 'subtractedValue' of decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).
Parameter 'newOwner' of transferOwnership(address).
Parameter 'who' of balanceOf(address).
Parameter 'owner_' of allowance(address,address).
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(address,address).
Local gonValue = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) computed inside transfer.
Local gonValue = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) computed inside transferFrom.
Local oldValue caching the current allowance inside decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
msg.sender is the untrusted input written into _owner by the Ownable constructor.
owner() returns the stored _owner value.
msg.sender is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner check.
The onlyOwner modifier executes the _owner == msg.sender comparison before the function body.
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), changing privileged state.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new owner address.
The newOwner parameter flows into the _owner state variable.
msg.sender is the untrusted caller used as initial owner in the token constructor.
EthereumHyper constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply with INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY.
Constructor credits TOTAL_GONS to _gonBalances[_owner].
Constructor derives _gonsPerFragment from TOTAL_GONS and _totalSupply.
totalSupply() returns the cached _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the caller-supplied account from _gonBalances.
balanceOf divides the gon balance by _gonsPerFragment.
The 'who' parameter indexes the _gonBalances mapping.
The 'to' parameter determines the credited account in transfer.
The 'value' parameter is the fragment amount moved in transfer.
msg.sender is the account debited by transfer.
_gonsPerFragment is the multiplier used to convert fragments into gons.
transfer performs value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) whose result depends on user input.
The user-supplied 'value' is an operand of the gon conversion multiplication.
The local gonValue stores the multiplication result for later debits and credits.
transfer subtracts gonValue from the sender balance, an arithmetic balance mutation.
The local gonValue is the subtrahend of the sender balance debit.
transfer adds gonValue to the recipient balance, an arithmetic balance mutation.
The local gonValue is the addend credited to the recipient.
transfer writes the updated balances back into _gonBalances.
The 'to' argument is validated by the validRecipient modifier.
validRecipient gates execution of transfer.
The 'from' parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
The 'value' parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed by transferFrom.
transferFrom subtracts value from the spender allowance, an arithmetic allowance mutation.
transferFrom multiplies value by _gonsPerFragment, an arithmetic conversion.
_gonsPerFragment is the multiplier in the transferFrom conversion.
The local gonValue in transferFrom stores the conversion result.
transferFrom decrements the _allowedFragments allowance entry.
transferFrom updates the gon balances of both accounts.
The 'to' argument of transferFrom is validated by validRecipient.
validRecipient gates execution of transferFrom.
The 'spender' parameter keys the allowance entry written by approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes _allowedFragments[msg.sender][spender] = value.
The 'spender' parameter keys the allowance entry updated by increaseAllowance.
The 'addedValue' parameter is the increment applied by increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the existing allowance, an arithmetic mutation.
increaseAllowance writes the updated allowance into _allowedFragments.
The 'spender' parameter keys the allowance entry updated by decreaseAllowance.
The 'subtractedValue' parameter is the decrement applied by decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
The local oldValue caches the allowance before the branch.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from oldValue, an arithmetic mutation.
oldValue is the minuend of the allowance subtraction.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance into _allowedFragments.
